title: Moraqmen CRM
tagline: Custom automated WhatsApp CRM for lead management. Seamlessly routes meta ads leads directly to agent conversation lists.

details.headerDesc: How we automated lead routing and cut client response time by 99% using Meta Webhooks and WhatsApp Cloud API integration.
problem: Moraqmen's sales team was drowning in manual data entry. Every time a new lead submitted a form via Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), an agent had to manually copy the lead's phone number, save it to their phone, and initiate a WhatsApp conversation.

This manual process took an average of 4-6 hours per lead, drastically reducing conversion rates as leads went cold. They needed a system to capture leads instantly and connect them with available sales agents immediately via WhatsApp.
details.architectureDesc: I architected a custom CRM middleware that sits directly between Meta's infrastructure and the client's sales team.

architecture.title: 01. Webhook Intake
architecture.desc: A highly available Node.js endpoint securely receives and verifies instant webhook payloads from Meta Lead Ads.

architecture.title: 02. WhatsApp Cloud
architecture.desc: Integration with WhatsApp Business API automatically sends a personalized greeting template to the lead within seconds.

architecture.title: 03. Agent Routing
architecture.desc: Smart agent assignment algorithms route active incoming conversations to logged-in agents' dashboards immediately.

technicalImplementation: Frontend: Clean single-page admin panel built with React, styled with Tailwind CSS, and optimized for quick updates.
Backend: Node.js Express server handling incoming webhooks from Meta, validating payload hashes, and routing data.
Database: PostgreSQL with relational models to track agent load, leads status, and template statistics.

title: Mithaq Life
tagline: Matchmaking application designed with React Native for high-performance mobile UX, utilizing a secure WordPress custom backend.

details.headerDesc: A modern, high-performance matchmaking app built with React Native for seamless user experiences, backed by a robust WordPress architecture.
problem: The client had a legacy matchmaking system that was slow, unresponsive, and lacked a mobile-first approach. Users struggled with complex navigation and slow load times.
They required a complete overhaul: transitioning to a native mobile experience while safely migrating user profiles and matchmaking data to a secure REST API backend.
details.architectureDesc: We bridged a modern React Native frontend with a highly customized WordPress CMS backend.

architecture.title: 01. Mobile UX Design
architecture.desc: Built from the ground up for smooth animations and instant feedback across both iOS and Android platforms.

architecture.title: 02. WP REST API
architecture.desc: Leveraging a heavily customized WordPress REST API for content management and JWT-based user authentication.

architecture.title: 03. Secure Matchmaking
architecture.desc: Implemented strict privacy controls, end-to-end encryption for chat, and strict data handling.

technicalImplementation: Frontend: React Native and Expo for a unified codebase, employing Reanimated for fluid 60fps micro-interactions.
Backend: WordPress Headless Architecture with heavily customized PHP plugins replacing standard theme logic.
State Management: Redux Toolkit for caching complex user profiles and matchmaking algorithms.

title: Sho9 Salla Store
tagline: Highly customized e-commerce Salla store optimized for speed, visual appeal, and smooth checkouts to scale up store sales.

details.headerDesc: A high-converting, visually striking Salla e-commerce store with fully customized styling and an optimized user flow.
problem: The standard Salla templates were rigid and didn't convey the premium aesthetic the brand required. Their checkout flow was cluttered, causing a high drop-off rate.
We needed to push the limits of Salla's Custom CSS and JS injections to create a bespoke shopping experience without losing the platform's reliable backend functionality.
details.architectureDesc: By leveraging Salla's advanced theme engine, we implemented massive styling overhauls and injected custom scripts to optimize flow.

architecture.title: 01. Visual Overhaul
architecture.desc: Overhauled the default theme to align with brand identity, ensuring a premium feel with custom typography and spacing.

architecture.title: 02. Checkout Flow
architecture.desc: Streamlined the purchasing process by hiding unnecessary fields and highlighting trust badges, reducing cart abandonment.

architecture.title: 03. Mobile First
architecture.desc: Rigorous testing across mobile devices to ensure tap targets and layouts are flawless on smaller screens.

technicalImplementation: Styling: Deep CSS overrides using Salla's Custom Theme Editor, ensuring robust fallback variables.
Scripts: Injected Vanilla JS micro-interactions for a more 'app-like' feel during the browsing phase.
Performance: Lazy loading implementation and asset optimization to ensure LCP under 2 seconds.
